title: MZ [RMMZ] Looking for Side-view Fire Shield Animation (Effekseer)

posts.author: Nephis
posts.body:
Hi everyone! I'm looking for a combat animation for a Side-view battle system. I need a fire shield effect: a spherical barrier made of flames that completely surrounds the ally sprite at its center, similar to a D&D shield spell. Since I'm using RPG Maker MZ, I'm specifically looking for an Effekseer (.efkefc) file. Thanks in advance for the help!
This is an Example:

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
You can use "normal" animation sheets in MZ as well.
Making MV Style Animations | The Official RPG Maker Blog
MZ’s default animation style uses Effekseer to create incredible animations, but it can be tough to get used to using it. And what if you prefer cell-based animation creation like in previous RPG Makers? Let’s take a look at how to make some MV-style animations in MZ thanks to the 1.4.0 update.
www.rpgmakerweb.com
That being said: I have not played around with the stuff I list, it could be fiddly.
But this recolored to orange might work:
エフェクトアニメ　回転する球体の光　２種 : ぴぽや 旧ブログ
This is a not very elemental but pretty solid shield effect
戦闘エフェクトアニメ　光球×10色 : ぴぽや 旧ブログ
Could also work
戦闘エフェクトアニメ　バリア×10色 : ぴぽや 旧ブログ
Probably my favourite so far
戦闘エフェクトアニメ　続・バリア２種×10色 : ぴぽや 旧ブログ
You might notice I type this out while I research, probably this is the best (I keep the old log so you can decide for yourself if you like a past suggestion more)
エフェクトアニメ　ワープゲート : ぴぽや 旧ブログ
Not as good imho for a shoield, but very fiery
junk くるくるファイアーエフェクトアニメ : ぴぽや 旧ブログ
Dunno if/how this would work, but it looks nice
エフェクトアニメ　太陽・ブラックホール・オーロラ : ぴぽや 旧ブログ
